affected_selection_rule: All cohort hotels whose accepted building ID+geometry sets differ between previous and FINAL snapshots; not a hardcoded hotel list.
source_hashing_method: Streaming SHA256 of large cached extracts; same digest, avoids reading an entire city extract into RAM.

effective_axis_input_manifest.edge_note: Geometry candidate uses first vertex within 0.015-degree padded bbox; very large polygons crossing with all first vertices outside could be missed. Full bbox hotel filter subsequently uses representative centroid.
effective_axis_input_manifest.sha256_kind: composite SHA256 of ordered road/rail input path+SHA manifests, not file hash
effective_axis_input_manifest.scope: N02/N03 axis layers only. No pedestrian graph/node supplement is required for footprint-to-axis distance.
